label: Reject unbalanced journals
note: Debits must equal credits before an entry can leave draft. Recommended and expected by auditors.

label: Enforce the two-person rule
note: The person who prepares an entry can never be the person who approves it, at any value.

label: Allow posting to closed periods
note: When off, a journal dated in a closed period is rejected. Reopening a period is logged and requires the Finance Manager.

label: Allow backdated postings within the open period
note: Permits corrections dated earlier in the same open month.

label: Auto-number journals and vouchers
note: References are issued in sequence per source type and cannot be reused.

label: Block postings that exceed the budget line
note: A hard stop rather than a warning. Blocked postings need a budget revision first.
